title: import_sieve drops the unused device_isolation rule kind
intention: import_sieve carries only rule kinds something declares.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i at main: git grep finds the device_isolation rule kind only in import_sieve/sieve.py and three tests in its own test_import_sieve.py; no rule set, charter or build_inspector declares it. RULE 1 is build_inspector's encapsulation_holds (124c0312c2d8). The kind split '/'-keyed graph paths on os.sep, so on Windows it found no devices and read green without looking (test_device_isolation_catches_cross_device_import red there). The orchestrator ruled: delete it.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 5 (the repo is the state of the machine); Law 8.
how: D1: sieve.py loses the device_isolation docstring paragraph, its elif branch, and its name in the unknown-kind error. D2: test_import_sieve.py loses its three device_isolation tests and their _main entries. D3: new proof test_the_device_isolation_kind_is_gone.py: the kind is refused as unknown, and sole_path still catches.

clauses.claim: a rule of kind device_isolation is refused as an unknown kind, and the refusal names no such kind
the kinds still in use still catch: a sole_path rule over a planted dialer reds it
